messages:
Elena: Quick sync We need a lightweight playbook for 'deprecation handshakes' with customers who request temporary pins but also demand guarantees on rollback economics. Need a concise decision flow.
Marcus: Agreed. Sales asks for a short template: pin length, bench bar, credit/escrow, and remediation limits. Customer-facing doc should be 1 page.
Tony: Operational constraints: we can support 30/60/90-day locks. Key knobs: (1) emergency hotfix carve-out, (2) number of remediation iterations (0/1/2), (3) escrow token amount.
Priya: Bench idea: minimal smoke + regression set. Propose "handshake-mini": 1k customer seeds + 500 golden probes. Metrics: quality_regression_rate, p95_latency_delta, token_inflation_pct. Pass if quality <=1.0% and p95 <= baseline+150ms and token_inflation <= 20%.
Elena: Draft snippet for the SOW bundle:
```
pin_length: 60d
bench_suite: handshake-mini
sample_count: 1500
metrics: [quality_regression_rate, p95_latency_ms, token_inflation_pct]
passes: [quality <= 1.0%, p95 <= baseline + 150ms, token_inflation <= 20%]
remediation_attempts: 2
escrow: 200000 tokens prepaid
```
Marcus: Commercials: propose 15% onboarding credit and offer optional paid 30-day extensions. Escrow is refundable if unused at window end. Make sure sales example includes a rollback-cost table.
Tony: Canary plan: shadow 10% for 48h, then 2% -> 20% -> 50% over 72h with auto-pause gates. Auto-rollback triggers: quality_regression_rate > pass_thresh OR p95 delta > pass_thresh OR error-rate +0.5%.
Priya: If bench fails, allow up to 2 iterations within 14 days. Eng-ML to provide remediation checklist and required fixes. After that, product presents options: extend lock (paid), revert and refund pro-rated credits, or engage paid migration services.
eng-qa-bot: INFO: bench-template "handshake-mini-v1" created. Run ID placeholder: run-1788-01.
Elena: Legal needs short clause: auto-expire, emergency-patch carve-outs, escrow handling (refund/overage billing), remediation windows, and a dispute resolution mechanism for bench disagreements.
Legal Bot: REMINDER  define "quality_regression_rate" measurement method, seed-set immutability, audit-log retention, and export-control/data-residency confirmations.
Elena: OK next steps: 1) Product to draft 1-page customer handshake template (this week). 2) Eng-ML to create bench runner and seed-set snapshot (EOD Thu). 3) Eng-Platform to validate canary template + escrow accounting. 4) Legal to provide clause draft. I'll post draft SOW here when ready. :white_check_mark:
